mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at any level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the rate level consistently reflects accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations across all economic conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 275 indicates elevated inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced future cash flows.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 275 and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% combined with unemployment below 4.5% signals a strong economy with accommodative policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and UNRATE < 4.5 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by unemployment below 4.5% and employment growth exceeding 0.5% in the prior month), strong labor market conditions predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained consumer spending.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 thousand units (HOUST > 1500) indicate robust consumer demand for housing, which precedes economic expansion and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.2% in the prior month (INDPRO(t) > INDPRO(t-1mo) * 1.002) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth > 0.2% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.8% signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated earnings contraction and risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.8 and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 thousand units (HOUST > 1500) combined with industrial production growth exceeding 0.2% (INDPRO(t) > INDPRO(t-1mo) * 1.002) indicates synchronized demand and supply strength, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO growth > 0.2% but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.
